main_body: altar block with white and lavender top cloth and dark purple front frontal on a stepped grey base
top_band: white and light-lavender horizontal altar top from row 11 to row 23, bounded by a gold front edge at row 24
evidence: Reading down column 14: row 10 is the grey back edge, rows 11-23 (13 rows) form a lighter horizontal top surface (white cloth with a light-lavender central runner), row 24 is a bright gold front-edge highlight line, row 25 is a darker gold under-edge shadow, and rows 26-35 (10 rows) form the darker purple vertical front face above a 3/4 stepped stone base (top rows 37-39, front rows 40-46).

style.evidence: Compared to prop-stall-cheese and prop-well-roofed, the candidate is built almost entirely from ruler-straight 1px bands and large unshaded flat fills: solid pure white rectangles (4x13 px), a flat single-tone lavender runner, completely unshaded 1-colour yellow crosses, flat purple panels, and a flat grey base with no stone or fabric texture.
